verdict.rationale: Docs confirm webhooks fire on Persona resource events and deliver real-time status updates (approved/declined/needs review) plus configurable filters, blocklists, and custom headers, and outbound deliveries can be authenticated via OAuth 2.0 client credentials — supporting event-driven, non-polling integration. However, the pack never explicitly documents payload signing/HMAC verification or enumerates the specific lifecycle states (created, processing, verified, requires-input) the story names. Missing for 10: explicit signature/HMAC verification mechanism, documented list of inquiry/verification lifecycle event types matching the story's named states.
